paper_title: New Constraints on Hidden Photons using Very High Energy Gamma-Rays from the Crab Nebula
suggested_experiment_name: Crab Nebula VHE gamma-ray hidden photon constraint (HEGRA/H.E.S.S./MAGIC/Whipple)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi, dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 2
notes: Paper derives hidden-photon kinetic mixing constraints from photon disappearance in VHE gamma-ray spectra of the Crab Nebula (HEGRA, H.E.S.S., MAGIC, Whipple). Combined limit chi_fit ~ 0.0343, with the bound converging to this value with increasing mass; validity extends up to mu ~ 1e-5 eV (coherence condition). The exclusion curve in Fig. 2 spans 1e-8 to 1e-5 eV, weakening below ~1e-7 eV where the oscillation length exceeds the source distance; only the flat asymptotic portion (~1e-7 to 1e-5 eV) is encoded here since intermediate curve values are not numerically given. IMPORTANT: the paper's stated confidence level is 68.3% (Delta chi2 = 1), not 90/95% — 0.90 entered only because the schema requires it. Not a DM search, so no local DM density assumed.
